svg.title: The five emitter shapes of the Idealized depth model
svg.desc: Five panels: SPHERICAL fans rays from one origin on a regular grid of azimuth and elevation; PLANAR spreads ray origins over a horizontal grid and points every ray straight down; CYLINDRICAL stacks horizontal rings of rays from the origin's height to maxRowUnit above it; GRIDLESS_SPHERICAL keeps a constant arc spacing so rows away from the horizontal plane hold fewer rays; BOX aims rays from one origin through evenly spaced points on the six faces of a box. A strip shows the sensor frame: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, azimuth from +X toward +Y, elevation from the horizontal plane toward +Z.

Sensor frame (ISO 8855): +X forward, +Y left, +Z up; origin is authored in this frame, relative to the prim's position. Azimuth is measured from +X
toward +Y, elevation from the horizontal plane toward +Z. Grids start at the minimum and stop one step short of the maximum (dashed).
